connectors.name: data_eia_electricity

connectors.name: data_eia_natural_gas

connectors.name: data_eia_steo

connectors.name: data_ember_energy
connectors.title: Ember Energy

connectors.name: data_energy_transition

connectors.name: data_global_forest_watch

connectors.name: data_iea
connectors.title: IEA (International Energy Agency)

Uses the keyless JSON endpoints behind the IEA Energy Statistics Data Browser (api.iea.org/stats/indicator); they are not a documented API and may change.

connectors.name: data_irena
connectors.title: IRENA Renewable Energy Statistics

connectors.name: data_metals_prices

connectors.name: data_noaa_climate

connectors.name: data_open_meteo

connectors.name: data_owid_co2

connectors.name: data_usda_ers

connectors.key_note: Without a key the shared api.data.gov DEMO_KEY is used (about 10 requests/hour per IP); a free api.data.gov key lifts the limit.

connectors.name: data_usda_nass
connectors.title: USDA NASS Quick Stats

connectors.name: data_world_bank_climate
